exposure: prophylactic continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) administration
cohort: Infants born by elective cesarean section between 34 and 39 weeks of gestation
finding: Prophylactic CPAP administration in the delivery room reduces the rate of NICU admission in late-preterm and early-term infants delivered by elective CS.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered by elective cesarean section who received prophylactic CPAP had a lower rate of NICU admission compared to those who did not.
